scholarships.title: COMSTECH Fellowships for Research and Advanced Training in Virology and Vaccine Technologies
scholarships.official_source: OIC-COMSTECH (Ministerial Standing Committee on Scientific and Technological Cooperation of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation)

eligibility: Be a citizen of an OIC member state
Be employed by a research institution in an OIC country
Work in any area of the biomedical sciences
Hold at least an M.S. in Biomedical/Health Sciences or equivalent for graduate studies, or a Ph.D. in Biomedical/Health Sciences for post-graduate studies
Be aged 35 or under for graduate studies, or 45 or under for post-graduate studies
Submit a supporting statement from the head of the home institution
Provide two reference letters from senior scientists familiar with the applicant's work, where the head of the home institution may not also be a referee
Apply for only one COMSTECH programme per calendar year
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to citizens of OIC member states who are young scientists employed by a research institution in an OIC country, holding at least an M.S. in Biomedical or Health Sciences for graduate-level application or a Ph.D. in Biomedical or Health Sciences for post-graduate-level application. Age limits are 35 for graduate studies and 45 for post-graduate studies, with preference given to women scientists, those early in their research career, and those working in OIC least-developed countries or Muslim-majority areas in non-OIC states.
benefits: Supervision and mentoring of local training
coverage: Supervision and mentoring of local training
requirements: Match the field: virology, genetic engineering or infectious diseases
Complete the official application form and email it to COMSTECH headquarters
Send a scanned passport copy, even if expired, showing name and surname
Send a CV of maximum five pages including publications
Send a supporting statement from the head of the home institution
Send two reference letters from senior scientists; the head of the home institution cannot be one of the referees
Send M.S./Ph.D. degrees and relevant university transcripts
Apply for only one COMSTECH programme per calendar year
documents: Completed official application form, emailed to khazima@comstech.org or comstech@comstech.org
Scanned copy of passport (name and surname page), expired copies accepted
CV of maximum five pages, including publications
Supporting statement from the head of the home institution
Two reference letters from senior scientists familiar with the applicant's work, not from the head of the home institution
M.S./Ph.D. degrees and relevant university transcripts
existing.english_requirement: Not stated on the official page. The fellowship is administered and reviewed in English, but no specific test or score is published, so none is asserted.
application_method: Complete the official COMSTECH application form
Assemble the six required supporting documents
Email the completed form and documents to khazima@comstech.org or comstech@comstech.org
Applications are jointly reviewed by an expert committee of COMSTECH and the host institutions
existing.selection_notes: Fellowships are awarded by COMSTECH together with the host institutions' Joint Fellowships Committee, based on scientific merit. The page states an age limit applies for various categories of scholarship but that preference is given to young scientists, particularly women scientists, those at the beginning of their research career, and those working in OIC least-developed countries or from Muslim-majority areas in non-OIC states.
existing.best_fit: Biomedical or health-science scientists aged 35 or under (45 for post-doctorals), citizens of OIC member states and employed at an OIC research institution, who hold an M.S. or PhD in a biomedical or health science and can spend three months at a centre of excellence in a different OIC country.
existing.notes: Applicants may apply for only one COMSTECH programme per calendar year, so this cannot be combined with another COMSTECH fellowship in the same year. The page states COMSTECH provides international low-cost airfare and that host institutions are expected to provide subsistence, supervision and mentoring; it does not state that tuition or enrolment fees are paid, so tuition_coverage is recorded as false and fully_funded as false. Eligibility spans OIC member states across Africa, the Middle East and Asia; region is set to Middle East because the awarding body's centres of excellence and the programme's framing are OIC-wide with heavy Middle East membership. The page lists awardee lists for cycle-1, cycle-2 and cycle-3, confirming this is a recurring annual cycle, and no closing date is published for the current round.
existing.application_period: Continuously open on the awarding body's own notice, with no published closing date; the page records Call Status: 'The call is currently open'
existing.deadline_display: No closing date published; the official page states 'The call is currently open'
